Tech Review Channel
What is the best size for a YouTube thumbnail?
The ideal size is 1280x720 pixels (with a minimum width of 640 pixels). Lovart automatically generates images in the correct 16:9 aspect ratio optimized for YouTube's requirements.
Can I put my own face in the AI thumbnail?
Yes! Use the 'Reference Image' or 'Face Swap' features. Upload a selfie, and the AI can place you into any scenario while maintaining your likeness, or simply enhance your existing photo.
Does text on thumbnails really help CTR?
Data shows that thumbnails with concise, punchy text (usually under 5 words) perform better. Lovart's Design Agent is trained to suggest text that complements the visual without cluttering it.
Can I create thumbnails for Shorts?
Absolutely. While Shorts thumbnails are less prominent, having a good cover is crucial for the channel page. Lovart allows you to switch to a 9:16 aspect ratio instantly.
Is it copyright safe?
Yes, all images generated by Lovart are unique and royalty-free. You own the commercial rights to the thumbnails you create, so you don't have to worry about copyright strikes.
